summary: Manager- Transport Operations (Field Engineer - Transport) at Vodafone Idea Limited, responsible for transport network operations and service experience.
responsibilities: Transport network acceptance with architecture compliance, quality of installation.
Proactive plan to mitigate network risks due to environment or other factors
Accountable to deliver the Network and service KPIs for transport network.
Deliver service experience to Mobility and enterprise customers.
Work closely with other functions in the circle and central to meet uptime, fault KPI, performance KPI and Change management KPI.
Disaster recovery operations and situation specific solutions to improve experience for Voice and Data services
Responsible for preventive maintenance of transport network to reduce outages, alarms , performance issues and equipment damage
Deliver the NOC demands, WFM compliance
Maintain NDD and physical connectivity details
Work with OEMs, transport, Infra ,OSP teams & NOC to reduce MTTR.
Deliver quality of the network through optimization, rerouting
Basic KPIs – a. Transport Network Availability >99.95%, MTTR of <4Hrs
Basic KPIs – b. Alarms-SA and NSA Like RSL Deviation, CRC Errors, FCS Errors, High Temperature etc
Basic KPIs – c. Performance Parameters – Latency, PacketDrop, Jitter etc
required_skills: Transport Access (ECI, Huawei) DWDM (Huawei, Ciena, Nokia PSS) and IP (Cisco, Nokia)
Understanding on technology Optics (SDH, Packet and DWDM) and IP (Routers and Switches)
nice_to_have_skills: Mobility services such as 4G, VoLTE desired
Hands on experience in managing Huawei/ECI/Ciena/ZTE/Infinera/Tejas /Cisco/Juniper/Nokia devices in a multi-vendor architecture
